topic_title: Reducing Risk — Licensing, Registration & Insurance Synthesis
prompt: Which walk-around check should an informed driver perform prior to entering the vehicle for roadway travel?

options.text: Verify the vehicle's paint glossiness, adjust radio volume, clean engine block exterior
Test high-speed horn volume repeatedly, check dashboard clock accuracy, wipe hubcaps
Inspect tires for inflation and tread depth, check clean lights, scan clear perimeter
Check that all door handles are unlocked and verify trunk spare tire tire iron brand
